leadStory: Alexander Isak scored a 20th-minute opener in Sweden's 2-1 Nations League win over Romania on Friday 25 September, per Liverpool FC, in the week he and Jeremy Jacquet were shortlisted for the Premier League's September Player of the Month.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is an international goal scored abroad in a Sweden shirt; the secondary surfaces are an awards shortlist, an academy transfer, an academy injury and a goalkeeper correction. None resolves into a Liverpool still. Antigravity should take no action.
